description: Draw a rectangular grid (Rectangular Grid tool, with its options dialog) as a group: horizontal and vertical dividers with skew, and the outside edges as one rectangle (Use Outside Rectangle As Frame) or as four lines. With fill, the frame is filled (Fill Grid)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

frame.description: Use Outside Rectangle As Frame: draw the outside edges as one rectangle. Default true

horizontalDividers.description: Number of horizontal lines between the top and bottom edges. Default 5

horizontalSkew.description: Skew, -500 to 500 percent. 0 spaces the dividers evenly; positive crowds them toward the top, negative toward the bottom, each gap being (1 + |skew|/100) times its neighbour. Default 0

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

verticalDividers.description: Number of vertical lines between the left and right edges. Default 5

verticalSkew.description: Skew, -500 to 500 percent. 0 spaces the dividers evenly; positive crowds them toward the right, negative toward the left, each gap being (1 + |skew|/100) times its neighbour. Default 0

x.description: Left edge of the grid, points from the artboard's left

y.description: Top edge of the grid, points from the artboard's top

name: create_rectangular_grid
title: Create Rectangular Grid
